title: Chapter 664
text:
Rumble!

The shockwaves from the battle between more than ten Calamity Grade Supers caused huge waves in the ocean. Huge whirlpools appeared in the area, and blue-black whirlpools covered the surface of the ocean, spinning non-stop.

The wind sucked in the seawater, forming waterspouts that connected the ocean and the dark clouds.

The bleak wind and bitter rain turned into a vast expanse of white vapor in the wind, drifting here and there.

Above the ocean, it was like the end of the world. It was as if nature had turned into a husky and was having fun.

The moment Han Xiao dived into the sea, these noises suddenly became indistinct, as if there was a layer of gauze between them. The seawater weakened the transmission of some of the sounds in the air, but the roaring of the turbulent currents in the sea was instantly magnified. It was as if he was in the middle of hundreds of drums, surrounded by three-dimensional surround sound, and muffled rumbles rolled in from all directions.

The radar showed that Stephanie had also dived into the ocean. Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

I have to hold her back first. I can't let her get close to me during the Promotion.

With that thought in mind, Han Xiao ordered the Mech Legion around him to turn around and hold her back while he dived down quickly.

The underwater world in front of him was deep. The distance turned from dark blue to pitch black, and the visibility was low. There was no light source here, and he could not see the end. It was even darker than the universe.

Luckily, I don't have deep-sea phobia, Han Xiao thought to himself.

The ocean was the hotbed of life. There were many ancient creatures in the ocean of Blue Star, but all the sea creatures in this area had escaped. The ocean was dead silent, without any signs of life.

Stephanie was held back by the Mech Legion. Han Xiao quickly moved under the ocean and found a trench that had just opened a few hours ago.

"Let's do it here."

Han Xiaoxin immediately opened the interface, selected the 'Completed' Promotion Mission, and activated it.

A tremor in his bones and soul quickly spread throughout his body. He was very familiar with this feeling of Promotion.

This time, a series of notifications popped up on the interface.

[Trial of the Strong]: Current Promotion Mission completed! END bonus increased! 1 END = 120 Health = 130 Stamina

You have taken one step further on the path of evolution. Your life level has been elevated. Detected race: [Chaos Observer (Human Form)] … Randomly drawing eight matching evolution paths … Drawing complete!

Please choose one of the eight options below as your evolved race. Warning! The evolution process is irreversible. Please choose carefully! [Appendix – Evolution Path Characteristics]

[X-type Space Human] -67% Compatibility

[Voidwalker (Human Form)] -78% Compatibility

[Gloom Shadow (Human Form)] -72% Compatibility

[Void Disciple (Human Form)] -71% Compatibility

[Void Distorter (Human Form)] -69% Compatibility

[Void Whisperer (Spirit Form)] -84% Compatibility

[Void Sludge Monster] Compatibility: 55-%

[Oca Octopus] -31%

First of all, non-void races were excluded. There was no need to consider octopus tentacles like the Octopus Clan. As for the Void Sludge, it was too weird, so it was also excluded.

The Void Whisperer was in the form of a spirit, suitable for Mages and Psychics. Han Xiao had a strong physique and would not give up his physical body.

The only reliable options were the four evolution options that retained his human form.

Han Xiao quickly browsed through and immediately made a choice.

The Void Lord's core had strengthened his Void genes. Because Han Xiao had jumped from the human evolution system to the Void evolution system, he was considered a half-way switch. Naturally, he could not compare to individuals who were Void species from the beginning. However, the Void Lord's core and other Void species genetic items had increased his evolution speed in the Void system, allowing his evolution speed to catch up.

Thanks to the Void Lord's core, there was an option for Race Evolution this time. This was a higher-level species in the Void evolution system. According to his data, this species was a whole level higher in the evolution chain compared to other normal options. It could make up for the part where he lagged behind!

Regardless of whether it was the current attribute increase or the future evolution potential, this species was the best choice!

Han Xiao quickly made his decision.

Selection complete. Race Evolution … Evolution complete!

Race changed to [Void Distorter (Human Form)]. Molecular structure improved, organ structure strengthened, metabolism changed, adaptability increased, genes optimized … Your potential has increased!

You have received attributes: + 44 STR, + 83 DEX, + 65 END, + 120 INT, + 92 MYS, + 34 CHA, + 1,460 Energy. Energy Level bonus attribute changed!

Han Xiao's eyes suddenly widened, and a deep light appeared in the depths of his pupils.

The cells and genes in his whole body changed, and his body and mind exploded with intense pain. His vision kept switching between reality and the Void World, and his brain was trembling.

His hungry body greedily absorbed the energy of the Void Dimension, and his whole body glowed with a mysterious gray light and a deep blue light.

The two evolutions he had undergone before were the Void Prowler and the Chaos Observer. If one were to evaluate the Void species in the army system, these two were different types of ordinary soldiers, and the Void Distorter was an existence at the level of a chiliarch!

He had directly jumped an entire level from a cannon fodder to a mid-level officer!

This Race Evolution had greatly deepened his connection with the Void Dimension. His body seemed to have become a vessel, and the Void Energy directly entered his body. Every cell was absorbing the Void Energy.

The energy that came from his cells also changed under the erosion of the Void Energy.

You have received the Void Energy buff!

+ 30% Energy Recovery Speed

+ 1,000 Energy

You have received a new Energy Attribute: [Void] — Your energy has the Void attribute.

A new Energy Attribute!

Han Xiao was overjoyed. He endured the pain and hurriedly looked at the interface. The interface showed two Energy Attributes. One was the Mechanic's Magnetic Mechanical Force, and the other was the newly obtained Void attribute.

Seeing this, Han Xiaoxin was so excited that he almost spurted out. He was in pain and happy at the same time.

The change in Energy Attribute was not as obvious as the attribute value, but it was very important. It could even change one's combat style.

Although the introduction of the interface was ambiguous, Han Xiao had already felt the changes in the energy in his body during the Race Evolution process. He could control it as he wished. Furthermore, he remembered the information from his previous life, so he was very clear about the effect of the [Void] attribute.

Energy erosion!

Using the Void Dimension as a medium to spread energy!

These two attributes were very powerful in actual combat, and it could be used with any class!

The evolution continued, and the Void Energy in his body gradually became saturated. It stirred the seawater and formed a giant whirlpool under the sea.

Han Xiao's Promotion attracted Stephanie's attention.

"I can't let him act as he pleases!"

Stephanie did not know what Han Xiao was doing, but that did not stop her from wanting to stop Han Xiao. She crazily shook the seawater, crushing mechanical soldiers one after another, and cleared a path.

She charged straight toward the center of the whirlpool and waved her hand.

Boom!

The whirlpool was shattered into turbulence in the blink of an eye. At the last moment, Han Xiao avoided being hit head-on and was only pushed far away by the shockwave.

Stephanie was a strong opponent. Han Xiao did not slowly experience the changes in his body. He glanced at the various new talents on the interface, then threw his experience into the interface and leveled up!

His experience decreased tremendously!

He leveled up fifteen times in a row!

Notifications popped up one after another.

After his class reached the max level, Han Xiao's leveling momentum stopped.

It was still the limit of all INT.

His total level was LV 195!

Han Xiao did not even have the time to look at the changes on his interface. The rapid increase in his strength made his body feel bloated. The abundant energy was about to burst every cell in his body, and he urgently needed to vent it out.

Without saying anything, Han Xiao put away the Mountain Ape mechanical suit, which had been destroyed twice, and charged toward Stephanie.

This time, Stephanie finally saw what Han Xiao looked like, and her expression changed.

Han Xiao's skin had turned silver-gray, with a crystalline texture and glowing with the light of energy. There were symmetrical dark blue patterns on his body, and his whole body was burning with silver flames fueled by Void Energy. His hair was floating in the sea and also turned silver-gray, like dancing flames.

His eyes turned into the color of obsidian, and his pupils turned into rice-sized white spots of light.

This appearance was somewhat similar to the Void Prowler in the past, but the energy wave he gave off was even more shocking.

New Race Talent — [Void Molt]!

"What is this …"

Stephanie was stunned.

At this moment, Han Xiao opened his hands, and half of his palm reached into the Void Dimension. His fingers formed a claw, and as if he was grabbing a canvas, he pulled with all his might.

"Try this!"

The next moment, the world in front of Stephanie's eyes suddenly became chaotic.

She felt as if all the muscles, bones, nerves, and blood vessels in her body had been squeezed into a ball before being kneaded by an invisible hand. She had an illusion that she had turned into a rag that was being twisted and twisted by someone to squeeze the juices out of her body.

It was just a short moment, but it felt like countless years had passed in her senses. This indescribable strange feeling was beyond the knowledge of most people. Stephanie felt like she had a dream. After she woke up, she forgot the content of the dream, but there was an incomparable feeling of insignificance in her heart, as if she had dreamed of something extremely terrifying.

Just as she was in a daze, endless pain suddenly exploded in every corner of her body!

Stephanie suddenly came back to her senses. Her expression changed, and she was alarmed. Just as she was about to retreat, the seawater around her started to spin rapidly, creating a terrifying suction force that made it difficult for her to escape.

"Sh * t!" Stephanie was shocked.

The changes there were also transmitted to the surface of the sea. All the small whirlpools in this chaotic area were torn apart by the turbulence and merged into a super giant whirlpool that looked like it was going to swallow the world!

Rumble!

The ten Calamity Grade Supers in the sky all stopped and looked at the terrifying whirlpool that stretched as far as the eye could see in shock.

In their eyes, the ocean was no longer an ocean but a deep starry sky. This whirlpool was like a black hole in the starry sky.

Deep, mysterious, and terrifying!

It was like the mouth of an abyss!

The only people who could create such a commotion could only be Han Xiao and Stephanie, who had entered the sea one after the other.

"What did they do in the sea?" Wilton's eyes widened in shock.

At the same time, in the sea …

Stephanie felt like she had been thrown into a washing machine. She floated up and down in the whirlpool, enduring the terrifying tearing damage.

In the center of the calmest whirlpool, Han Xiao held onto the Void Dimension tightly with both hands. A huge resistance came from his hands, and he could only maintain the current situation even with all his strength. The energy in his body was rapidly depleted and released through his hands.

"The evolved species this time is so strong!"

Han Xiao was also shocked by the effect of this attack.

This move was the new innate ability of Void Distorter.
